solutions.fullSolution: Robot learning methods replace or shortcut specific pieces of the model-based stack when its assumptions break down. Example: dynamics modeling (DYN-01) shortcut by system identification/dynamics learning (RLEARN-01); or optimal control (DYN-04) shortcut by learning a value/Q-function (RL-02/RL-03); or IK (KIN-03) shortcut by a policy/sampler satisfying the constraint directly.

criteria.description: Correctly explains it in one sentence and identifies the three (or a valid fourth) modules.

solutions.fullSolution: The privileged-teacher pattern: train with information unavailable at deployment (a privileged expert, simulator, or exact-pose computation), generate labels/data from it, then train a deployment-time model on only what's actually available. Instances: RLEARN-02's DAgger, RLEARN-04's sim2real, RLEARN-06's grasp labels, and RLEARN-07's Deep Visual Constraints.
